original_question: Let (N, g) be an orientable closed hyperbolic surface. Is the Hofer-Zehnder capacity of the unit disk cotangent bundle (D^*N, d lambda) finite?
target_in_paper: Johanna Bimmermann, standalone Question: after fixing a hyperbolic metric and reducing to the unit cotangent disk bundle, the paper asks whether the Hofer-Zehnder capacity of the unit disk cotangent bundle of an orientable closed hyperbolic surface is finite.
correct_elements: Your draft is already very close to the paper's exact target. It keeps the orientable closed hyperbolic surface hypothesis, asks about the unit disk cotangent bundle, and asks exactly for finiteness of the Hofer-Zehnder capacity.
missing_details: The paper first fixes a hyperbolic metric g and then uses D_g^*N as shorthand for the corresponding unit cotangent disk bundle; to be fully stand-alone, D_g^*N should be defined explicitly.
The symplectic form should be identified as dλ, where λ is the canonical Liouville 1-form on T^*N.
The official formulation is the inequality c_HZ(D_g^*N, dλ) < infinity.

The nearby context explains that one may equivalently formulate the question for the radius-r cotangent disk bundle D_{r,g}^*N for any r > 0, because the paper reduces to the unit-radius case by fiberwise scaling.

The orientability hypothesis is intentional and should not be dropped: the paper explains that some non-orientable hyperbolic surfaces are excluded because a Lagrangian-embedding argument already gives finiteness there.
No ambient ring, field, homogeneity, degree, or nilpotency data are relevant here; the missing content is geometric notation and the precise capacity statement.
refined_question: Let N be a closed orientable surface of genus at least 2 equipped with a hyperbolic metric g, let D_g^*N := {(q,p) in T^*N : |p|_g <= 1} be its unit cotangent disk bundle, and let λ denote the canonical Liouville 1-form on T^*N. Is the Hofer-Zehnder capacity c_HZ(D_g^*N, dλ) finite?
equivalent_formulation: Equivalently, for a fixed closed orientable hyperbolic surface (N,g) and any radius r > 0, if D_{r,g}^*N is the radius-r cotangent disk bundle, is c_HZ(D_{r,g}^*N, dλ) finite? The paper reduces the problem to the unit-radius case using the radius-r bundles and fiberwise scaling.
justification: The draft clearly targets the standalone Question in Johanna Bimmermann's contribution, not the later periodic-orbit growth problems. In the immediately preceding context, the paper fixes a hyperbolic metric, introduces the radius-r disk cotangent bundles, and explains that it is enough to ask about the unit disk cotangent bundle. The exact question is then the finiteness of c_HZ for an orientable closed hyperbolic surface. The sentence immediately following the question explains why orientability is included, so that restriction is paper-critical and should be retained. Apart from defining D_g^*N and λ explicitly, your draft already matches the paper well.
